units.displayText: However, Miss Lind, I never would have imagined that you'd have undergone hematological experimentation as well.

spans.text: However, Miss Lind, I never would have imagined that you'd have undergone hematological experimentation as well.

units.rawText: You... Why would you ask if you didn't already know?
units.displayText: You... Why would you ask if you didn't already know?

spans.text: You... Why would you ask if you didn't already know?

units.rawText: Jeez, I really can't let go of a single cycle of speech logic analysis with Miss Lind here, can I?
units.displayText: Jeez, I really can't let go of a single cycle of speech logic analysis with Miss Lind here, can I?

spans.text: Jeez, I really can't let go of a single cycle of speech logic analysis with Miss Lind here, can I?

units.rawText: I don't mind. How much did Boss tell you?
units.displayText: I don't mind. How much did Boss tell you?

spans.text: I don't mind. How much did Boss tell you?

units.rawText: She only said that you were a clinical trial Doll, with a veritable archive of information stored within.
units.displayText: She only said that you were a clinical trial Doll, with a veritable archive of information stored within.

spans.text: She only said that you were a clinical trial Doll, with a veritable archive of information stored within.

units.rawText: But this extent of data availability, this many trials, to be able to even provide data for such specific questions... is truly wonderful!
units.displayText: But this extent of data availability, this many trials, to be able to even provide data for such specific questions... is truly wonderful!

spans.text: But this extent of data availability, this many trials, to be able to even provide data for such specific questions... is truly wonderful!

units.rawText: Just being the humans' guinea pig, at the end of the day.
units.displayText: Just being the humans' guinea pig, at the end of the day.

spans.text: Just being the humans' guinea pig, at the end of the day.

units.rawText: But is that not something so great?
units.displayText: But is that not something so great?

spans.text: But is that not something so great?

units.rawText: Hmm?
units.displayText: Hmm?

spans.text: Hmm?

units.rawText: Lind looked at Elaugh. She heard a certain bizarre sort of ardor in her voice.
units.displayText: Lind looked at Elaugh. She heard a certain bizarre sort of ardor in her voice.

spans.text: Lind looked at Elaugh. She heard a certain bizarre sort of ardor in her voice.

units.rawText: Ever since Magrasea's link was severed, we've lost all means of accessing a clinical database in the real world.
units.displayText: Ever since Magrasea's link was severed, we've lost all means of accessing a clinical database in the real world.

spans.text: Ever since Magrasea's link was severed, we've lost all means of accessing a clinical database in the real world.

units.rawText: No more iterations could be made with our research well and truly stagnated.
units.displayText: No more iterations could be made with our research well and truly stagnated.

spans.text: No more iterations could be made with our research well and truly stagnated.

units.rawText: Now thanks to you, Lind, all of this will change.
units.displayText: Now thanks to you, Lind, all of this will change.

spans.text: Now thanks to you, Lind, all of this will change.

units.rawText: She gestured at the data streams.
units.displayText: She gestured at the data streams.

spans.text: She gestured at the data streams.

units.rawText: Look. Each and every one of these numbers will become the very soul of our research, and their fruits will be anointed unto many.
units.displayText: Look. Each and every one of these numbers will become the very soul of our research, and their fruits will be anointed unto many.

spans.text: Look. Each and every one of these numbers will become the very soul of our research, and their fruits will be anointed unto many.

units.rawText: These numbers, these keys for the door yet unopened, are within your hands, deserved for your sacrifice in flesh and blood.
units.displayText: These numbers, these keys for the door yet unopened, are within your hands, deserved for your sacrifice in flesh and blood.

spans.text: These numbers, these keys for the door yet unopened, are within your hands, deserved for your sacrifice in flesh and blood.

units.rawText: I don't think I'm anyone too special.
units.displayText: I don't think I'm anyone too special.

spans.text: I don't think I'm anyone too special.

units.rawText: The pleasantries were beginning to wear on Lind, but Elaugh showed no signs of pausing.
units.displayText: The pleasantries were beginning to wear on Lind, but Elaugh showed no signs of pausing.

spans.text: The pleasantries were beginning to wear on Lind, but Elaugh showed no signs of pausing.

units.rawText: Don't say that, Lind. You're incredible.
units.displayText: Don't say that, Lind. You're incredible.

spans.text: Don't say that, Lind. You're incredible.

units.rawText: Maybe you say that because you just don't know what I do exactly for work.
units.displayText: Maybe you say that because you just don't know what I do exactly for work.

spans.text: Maybe you say that because you just don't know what I do exactly for work.

units.rawText: Perhaps, but I understand. We're birds of a feather, you know. Each and every agent here in the Ascension Sector. We're the same as you.
units.displayText: Perhaps, but I understand. We're birds of a feather, you know. Each and every agent here in the Ascension Sector. We're the same as you.

spans.text: Perhaps, but I understand. We're birds of a feather, you know. Each and every agent here in the Ascension Sector. We're the same as you.

units.rawText: We're all one of a kind. Sacrificial lambs, to be submitted to humanity.
units.displayText: We're all one of a kind. Sacrificial lambs, to be submitted to humanity.

spans.text: We're all one of a kind. Sacrificial lambs, to be submitted to humanity.

units.rawText: As she gushed forth callous words, Elaugh's face wore upon it the semblance of intoxication, as if conversing about her most covetable longings.
units.displayText: As she gushed forth callous words, Elaugh's face wore upon it the semblance of intoxication, as if conversing about her most covetable longings.

spans.text: As she gushed forth callous words, Elaugh's face wore upon it the semblance of intoxication, as if conversing about her most covetable longings.

units.rawText: <color=orange>Tell me, Lind. Are we not alike?</color>
units.displayText: Tell me, Lind. Are we not alike?

spans.text: Tell me, Lind. Are we not alike?
